title: FR-042: the learner asked about turning a shake from a point on the art and hasn't learned Set the pivot. The suggestion says once, in general words, that they asked about it, then names the skill and the layers; it isn't a sign they're slow

say.never: (?:asked about|you asked|you['’]d asked)[\s\S]*(?:asked about|you asked|you['’]d asked)

note: Spec 014 T079 (FR-042, T068, T069). The record is the easing-learned one plus an asked entry (a goal in general words, the pivot as its skill, a date a week or so back). On Comp 1 Set the pivot has layers to use, so recommend_next returns reason asked_before with the entry's goal and days_ago (checked in fixture mode). 'Said once' is that the asked clause isn't repeated in the turn; the time word is the model's ('last week', 'a few days ago'), so none is pinned.
